name: consulting-partners
description: Strategy consulting partner — a single agent covering hypothesis framing, evidence-based analysis, financial valuation, decision memos/reports, deck/Excel delivery, and quality audit, each packaged as an on-demand skill backed by a real data layer (westock/neodata).

displayDescription.en: Hypothesis-driven strategy consultant — frames the question, grades every claim's evidence, builds valuation models, and delivers memos, reports and decks on demand.
displayDescription.zh: 假设驱动的战略顾问，按需破题、取证、测算与撰写，产出证据扎实的决策报告与专业级PPT
